name: lasso_feature_select_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: With dozens of potential indicators (RSI, MACD, BB, VWAP, volume ratios, etc.), overfitting is the primary risk. LASSO (Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator) regression automatically selects the most predictive features by shrinking unimportant coefficients to zero. By fitting a LASSO model on the last 5 days of 1-min data with the target variable being the 20-bar forward return and 15 potential features, the non-zero coefficients identify which indicators are currently predictive. We trade only when the LASSO-selected features collectively predict a forward return exceeding the cost threshold. The inefficiency exists because most traders either use too few indicators (missing information) or too many (overfitting). LASSO finds the optimal sparse set.
mechanism: Institutional order flow arrives in bursts via algorithmic execution (TWAP/VWAP slicing), creating persistent directional pressure over 30-120 seconds. Retail and smaller participants follow the initial move, extending momentum before liquidity absorbs the flow and the order book rebalances.

conditions: LASSO_Prediction > 15 bps (predicted forward return exceeds cost threshold)
Active_Features >= 3 (at least 3 features are predictive — not degenerate model)
Active_Features <= 7 (not too many — prevents overfitting signal)

exit.signal_exit: LASSO_Prediction sign flips (model now predicts opposite direction)

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; re-train LASSO model if VIX regime changes significantly

weaknesses: LASSO assumes linear relationships between features and forward returns — non-linear interactions (e.g., RSI matters only when VIX is high) are missed, potentially leaving alpha on the table
The alpha regularization parameter (0.001) is fixed but should ideally be cross-validated — too high zeroes out important features, too low loses regularization benefit and overfits
R² > 0.02 threshold for model quality is extremely low — a model that explains only 2% of return variance may not generate reliable predictions despite passing the threshold
prior_art: Tibshirani (1996) LASSO; Gu, Kelly & Xiu (2020) 'Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning'; LASSO for feature selection in trading is increasingly common in quant research; Moritz & Zimmermann (2016) on regularized regression for cross-sectional return prediction
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
